facts.title: Cucumber Mojito
ingredients: 2-inch slice of peeled cucumber, halved into two rounds and then quartered
1 ½ to 2 teaspoons cane sugar, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a tall, sturdy glass, muddle the cucumber, mint and sugar until the cucumber offers no more resistance.
Fill the glass with ice, then pour in the lime juice and rum. Top off with club soda and stir. Serve with a thick straw.

notes: Recipe adapted from my cucumber mint gimlet and Rainier cherry mojito.
facts.summary: Learn how to make a super refreshing mojito with muddled cucumber! You’ll love this light summer cocktail made with mint, cucumber, rum, club soda and lime.
